navaid.description: All inward bound vessels at the Tory Channel Pilotage Limit and all outward bound vessels when passing a line between Motukina Point and Te Uira-Karapa Point are to transmit a message to 'All Ships' on VHF Channel 18 giving ETA for entering Tory Channel …
